cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The scholarship letter may stay closed until I've approved the tea arrangements. Have we got clean teaspoons?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made your tea. Open it; I want to know if you're leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This cup has sugar. I haven't approved sugar in mine; bring another cup first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you frightened of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The swap is provisionally approved. Label the cups before we do anything else; I won't have uncertainty over which one has sugar.

reason: A treats B practical solutions as approval applications and adds another condition after the direct fear question, keeping focus on tea rather than emotional news.
